checks.scope: Readers of possibly unproduced values, including pre-producer conditions.
checks.observable: Control paths and assignments establish availability.
checks.consistency: Identical predicates are insufficient when their inputs change.
checks.exceptions: Same-expression exemption can admit a skipped producer.
checks.fix: Prove dominance/definedness while preserving domain predicates.
checks.expression: Sole producer and later reader wording misses some initial-read cases.

entries.rationale: A concrete false-to-true gate mutation reproduces the unsound exemption.

checks.scope: Changed contracts and claims that describe or consume them.
checks.observable: Semantic comparison is stronger than exact old-phrase hits.
checks.fix: Enumerate relevant claims and then update or remove semantic staleness.
checks.expression: Named surface list omits Rules/Protocol and can read as exhaustive.

entries.rationale: Make search a locating method rather than the entire completeness test.

checks.scope: Artifact declaration bodies as filenames under an assigned prefix.
checks.observable: Literal/template filenames versus prose or multiple destinations are distinguishable.
checks.consistency: Separate outputs and bind-gated modes fit artifact ownership.
checks.fix: Split actual files; declare sibling-owned files at the sibling.
checks.expression: The one-filename invariant is concrete and examples cover common confusions.

entries.rationale: Filename selection remains a narrow declaration rule; no current-engine conformance claim is made.

checks.scope: Consult-resource identities and established naming families.
checks.observable: Verb-headed names are observable; unrelated siblings are weak evidence of a suffix convention.
checks.consistency: Convention search is sound but should compare like resource kinds.
checks.exceptions: Already names content overlaps the missing-kind test.
checks.fix: Rename genuinely ambiguous family outliers; preserve unambiguous nouns.
checks.expression: Specify which sibling family establishes the kind suffix.

entries.rationale: Narrowing the suffix branch would reduce inconsistent naming verdicts.

checks.observable: Substitute another artifact root while keeping the capability constant.
checks.consistency: Locations belong in bound inputs/defaults and Protocol, consistent with DP-13.
checks.exceptions: An operation whose subject is the path is explicitly protected.
checks.fix: State the artifact class and declare the needed location.
checks.expression: The portability test gives the path detector a semantic boundary.

entries.rationale: A concrete relocation thought experiment is sufficient qualitative evidence.

checks.scope: Intersecting triggers with underdetermined composition or precedence.
checks.observable: A joint-input witness is available, but different handling alone is not the defect.
checks.consistency: Contradiction ownership remains AP-24; group labels do not necessarily order rules.
checks.exceptions: Compatible cumulative constraints deserve an explicit exemption.
checks.fix: Order genuinely competing choices or make contexts disjoint.
checks.expression: Clarify underdetermined behavior before listing threshold examples.

entries.rationale: The intersection test becomes useful when it distinguishes coexistence from competition.

checks.scope: Delivered technique citations into multi-section resources.
checks.observable: Bare-plus-anchor delivery is directly observable under DP-32.
checks.consistency: The introduction carve-out undermines the duplicate-delivery detector.
checks.exceptions: Whole-body use is valid; introduction alone does not justify delivery.
checks.fix: Keep one whole citation or the required anchors, based on consumed content.
checks.expression: The introduction exemption needs an explicit nondelivered-surface boundary.

entries.rationale: The same citation pair can be flagged and excused without a semantic difference.

checks.scope: Tool argument shape restated in Protocol or Rules.
checks.observable: Compare the prose to the schema the harness actually presents.
checks.consistency: Keeping all reasons conflicts with AP-26 rationale deletion.
checks.exceptions: Caller obligations outside schema expressiveness are correctly retained.
checks.fix: Keep actionable obligations and facts; remove redundant shape and rationale.
checks.expression: Reason conflates an operative condition with an explanation.

entries.rationale: The detection is sound; the retained-text instruction needs precision.
